text:
ash_cs: Quick ask — I dug into the healthscore cohort and we’re seeing a lot of accounts tumbling below the engage threshold because contact signals are stale (last activity / last touch > 180d). Proposing a ‘signal decay’ policy: weight contacts by age so >180d = 0.5, >365d = 0.0, and automatically enqueue a recontact playbook for accounts that fall < 60 after decay. Thoughts?

 tom_pdt: curious about magnitude — how many accounts affected if we flip this on? rough numbers pls.

 ash_cs: quick snapshot: ~4.2k accounts (6% of book) would drop 10–30 points, ~1.1k (1.6%) would drop >30. SQL I used: ```SELECT count(*) as n, avg(health_before-health_after) as avg_drop FROM healthscore_snapshot WHERE last_touch_days > 180;```

 lee_sre: 👍 love the automation angle. For playbook enqueue: prefer a dry-run in sandbox org first. Also we need rate-limits so we don't hit CRM API bulk limits during recontact.

 sam_gs: can we gate by ARR tier? If a $100k ACV account drops, we probably want manual review before auto-enqueue. Suggest: auto for <$25k, manual review for >=25k.

 gonzalo_data: agree on tiers. Recommend an A/B rollout: 5% of eligible accounts get the decay policy to validate downstream signals (open rates, reply rate). We should track: contact reopen rate, playbook acceptance, downstream renewal delta.

 ash_cs: good call. proposed rollout plan: 1) run analysis + dry-run for 7 days (sandbox), 2) A/B 5% live for 14 days, 3) widen to 25% if metrics OK, 4) full rollout with ARR gating. I’ll bake this into the playbook definition.

 tom_pdt: what about healthscore history — we should keep a shadow field so we can revert quickly and also for evals (decayed_healthscore vs healthscore).

 ash_cs: yep will add `decayed_healthscore` and persist both. Also adding a flag `decay_applied_ts`.

 lee_sre: for observability: add alerts if recontact queue grows >5000 or CRM 429s spike >5% in 1h. Also add a tracing tag `decay-rollout:v1`.

 sam_gs: small UX ask — CS console should surface which accounts had decay applied and the top stale signals per account (last_email_open, last_product_use).

 playbook-bot: playbook draft created: `decay_recontact_v1` — conditions: decayed_healthscore < 60 AND arr_tier = low. Actions: enqueue recontact task, add owner notification, tag `decay-triggered`.

 deploy-bot: workflow created in sandbox: decay_recontact_v1 (id: wf_20231101_17). Dry-run mode ON.

 ash_cs: thanks all — action items: I’ll open a PR with schema changes (decayed_healthscore, decay_applied_ts), gonzalo please set up A/B buckets, lee will add alerts, tom will add shadow field logic to score pipeline, sam will define ARR tiers and console UX changes. Targeting sandbox dry-run start next Tue. :calendar:

 gonzalo_data: got it — I’ll post cohort counts and the A/B assignment script here before EOD tomorrow.

 tom_pdt: I’ll stub the pipeline changes as a feature branch. ping me if you need the SQL metrics included in dashboards.

 ash_cs: perfect. marking as follow-up in CS board. thanks :thumbsup:
